shellCommands.command: git diff && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v package-lock && cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/package.json && node -p "require('next/package.json').version"
cd /workspace; for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx tsconfig.json; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -rl "cacheComponents" . | head -20; grep -rn -A3 "randomUUID\|Math.random" 01-app/03-api-reference/04-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md 2>/dev/null | head; ls ../../dist/docs/01-app/02-guides | grep -i cach

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; for i in 1 2; do curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Request <!-- -->[^<]*<!-- -->[^<]*<!-- -->[^<]*<!-- -->[^<]*<!-- -->[^<]*\|Request [^<]*generated[^<]*' | head -1; done; grep -o '<nav>Operations</nav>' .next/server/app/index.html; grep -c 'Loading request details' .next/server/app/index.html; pkill -f "next start" ; true
git status --short && git diff tsconfig.json; grep -rn "instant\|dynamic =" app components || echo "no opt-outs"
